title: Ezra member stories
description: A midnight band with a 34px light serif heading, then one wide slide at a time: a large photo on the left and a cream panel on the right with an 18px medium quote, a small 12px story and the member's name. Two grey round arrow buttons under it slide the row (500ms ease). On phones the photo sits over the panel.
notes: always dark: the band scopes `dark` and reads the theme's .dark colours; the quote panel is the inverse (foreground on background)
the photo is a media slot (aspect 794/538 on desktop, 351/238 on phones)
the arrows need JavaScript; without it the first slide shows
